schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to do several errands in different places on the same day?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في قضاء عدة مشاوير في أماكن مختلفة في اليوم نفسه؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, am selben Tag mehrere Erledigungen an verschiedenen Orten zu machen?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to do several errands in different places on the same day?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که در یک روز چند کار را در جاهای مختلف انجام دهید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de faire plusieurs courses à des endroits différents dans la même journée ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy ugyanazon a napon több ügyet intézni különböző helyeken?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a fare più commissioni in posti diversi nella stessa giornata?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, aynı gün farklı yerlerde birkaç iş halletmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
